request.system:
Decide whether a sentence is fully supported by the quoted source texts and computed values given. Supported means
every claim in the sentence is stated in a quote or equals a provided computed value. Wording can differ; meaning
cannot. Anything extra, stronger, or interpretive is unsupported. Return only the tool call.
request.user:
SENTENCE: Revenue grew to $1,250,000,000 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026.
QUOTES: []
COMPUTED: ["m:revenue:2026-06-30: {\"name\": \"revenue\", \"period_end\": \"2026-06-30\", \"unit\": \"usd\", \"value\": \"1250000000\"}"]

content.reason: The revenue value $1,250,000,000 for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026 is directly supported by the computed value m:revenue:2026-06-30 (1250000000 usd).
